body:
PROBLEM. `packages/skill-rot/lib/extract-claims.mjs` `processInlineCode` turns every backtick span that is not path-like into a `command` claim when its first whitespace token matches /^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_.-]*$/. `verify-claims.mjs` then reports `command not found`. API names, option names, tool names, model ids, enum values and file names written in backticks therefore all go stale, so the gate is noise and nobody can use it to notice real rot. `processCodeLine` does the same for every line of every fenced block, whatever its language, so TypeScript (`const`), YAML and box-drawing diagrams (`Vague request, no ticket yet? ───→`) become commands too.

EVIDENCE (measured on this branch's base, upstream/main 780c3400, with the in-tree extractor). (1) The deployed OpenCode router `plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md`, checked as `.opencode/skills/adlc/SKILL.md` in a consumer repo (Mentimeter mm-js, adlc CLI 1.12.0), is stale on `adversarial-review`, `execute.before`, `edit` (from "`edit`/`write`") and `advisoryHooks`: 4 of its 6 stale claims are false positives. (2) mm-js `.agents/skills`: 47 skills, 0 clean, 46 stale; inline spans give 167 ok and 905 stale command claims (for example `followUp.implementationSkill`, `typescript`, `node_modules`, `SKILL.md`, `github.blobBaseUrl`, `untranslated-string-audit.profile.yml`, `gpt-5.6-terra-high`, `claude-opus-4-8-thinking-high`). (3) This repo's 30 tracked SKILL.md files: inline spans give 131 ok and 167 stale; unlabelled fences give 42 stale diagram lines; `bash`/`sh` fences give 80 ok and 2 stale.

WHAT TO BUILD. The full design, the alternatives weighed and the measurements are in `.adlc/specs/skill-rot-command-claims.md`. Normative rules:
- R1 (command-shaped word). A token is command-shaped when it matches /^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$/: lowercase first letter, then lowercase letters, digits, `_` or `-`. A dot, an uppercase letter or any other character disqualifies it.
- R2 (inline span). After the existing path check (unchanged), an inline span is a command claim only when its first token is command-shaped AND one of: (a) the first token is a known launcher: adlc npx npm pnpm yarn bun bunx node deno git gh docker make python python3 pip cargo go curl sh bash; (b) a later token is a flag (/^--?[A-Za-z]/); (c) the span starts with `$ ` (an explicit shell prompt, stripped before reading the first token). A single bare word that is not a launcher is a name, not a command.
- R3 (fenced block). A fenced block yields claims only when its info string is empty or its first word is a shell language: sh bash zsh shell console shell-session terminal fish ksh. Inside such a block a line is a command claim only when its first token (after the existing `$ `/`> ` prompt strip) is command-shaped; the existing path handling of a line is unchanged.
- R4 (linked code span). A code span that is the entire text of a markdown link whose target is an absolute http(s) URL, as in [`docs/x.md`](https://example.com/x), yields no claim. A link with a relative target is unchanged.
- R5. Script references (`npm run X`, `pnpm X`, `yarn X`) are unchanged.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
AC1 Name-shaped inline spans give no command claim: `execute.before`, `advisoryHooks`, `edit`, `write`, `adversarial-review`, `followUp.implementationSkill`, `typescript`, `node_modules`, `SKILL.md`, `github.blobBaseUrl`, `untranslated-string-audit.profile.yml`, `gpt-5.6-terra-high`, `claude-opus-4-8-thinking-high`, `spec_hash`, `PreToolUse`, `compare before.json after.json`, `refname is ambiguous`. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs
AC2 Invocation-shaped inline spans still give a command claim on their first token: `ls -la` -> ls, `definitely-not-a-binary-xyz --flag` -> definitely-not-a-binary-xyz, `npx adversarial-review` -> npx, `git` -> git, `$ removed-cli-xyz` -> removed-cli-xyz, `pg_dump -Fc db` -> pg_dump. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs
AC3 Fences: no claim from ```ts `const x = 1`, ```json, ```text or ```yaml lines, or from a box-drawing diagram line in an unlabelled fence; a command claim from ```bash `removed-cli-xyz build`, ```console `$ git status`, and an unlabelled fence's `git status`. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs
AC4 [`docs/x.md`](https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/docs/x.md) gives no path claim; [`docs/x.md`](../docs/x.md) and a bare `docs/x.md` still give one. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs
AC5 Real rot still fails the gate end to end: the real `bin/skill-rot.mjs`, run in a temp repo whose only skill documents `removed-cli-xyz --version` in a bash fence, exits 2 and names the command; a skill whose only spans are the AC1 names exits 0 and reports it as having no claims. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs
AC6 The real `plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md` yields no command claim named adversarial-review, execute.before, edit, write or advisoryHooks. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/command-claims.test.mjs
AC7 The existing skill-rot suites stay green. A fixture that used a bare single word as a command changes only its input text (for example `ls` -> `ls -la`); no assertion is removed or weakened. Verify: node --test packages/skill-rot/test/*.test.mjs, and `git diff "$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD)" -- packages/skill-rot/test | grep -E '^-\s*assert'` prints nothing.
AC8 `packages/skill-rot/README.md` and `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/skill-rot.mdx` state R1-R4 and the launcher and shell-language lists. Verify: grep -c -e 'command-shaped' -e 'shell-session' -e 'launcher' packages/skill-rot/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/skill-rot.mdx (each count > 0).
AC9 Full suite and PR gates green. Verify: npm run preflight

OUT OF SCOPE. A per-span opt-out marker; shell continuation lines and shell functions defined inside a block; checking that `adlc <subcommand>` exists; script-reference scanning inside non-shell fences; the C10 wording in ADLC.md; skill text elsewhere in the repo (a separate ticket fixes the deployed router links).

TIER. `packages/skill-rot` is not a trust-root package (not rails-guard, prosecute, gate-manifest or build-gate), so a same-model P5 is sufficient; confirm with `adlc prosecute tier-check` if in doubt.
title: skill-rot: count an inline code span as a command claim only when it is shaped like an invocation
